scenes.caption: A question.
scenes.say: Zainab asks, what do hedgehogs eat? She goes to find out.

scenes.caption: The book.
scenes.say: She picks a non-fiction book about garden animals.

scenes.caption: Contents.
scenes.say: The contents page says hedgehogs are on page 12.

scenes.caption: Heading.
scenes.say: A heading says All About Hedgehogs. She is in the right place.

scenes.caption: A diagram.
scenes.say: A labelled diagram points to the spines and the nose.

scenes.caption: Facts.
scenes.say: Fact one. Hedgehogs eat beetles and worms.

scenes.caption: The index.
scenes.say: The index at the back lists hedgehog in ABC order.

scenes.caption: A fact file.
scenes.say: Zainab makes a fact file with a heading, facts and a label.
